'''Jon's wife''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] wife of the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] named [[Jon (Corellian)|Jon]] living in [[Coronet City]] during the the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] in [[3640 BBY]] Jon an his wife had an argument and he went out to clear his head. Unfortunately, when the [[rocket tram]]s stopped working, he got trapped in the [[Axial Park]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jon's wife appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an unnamed NPC at the [[Blastfield Shipyards]] rocket tram station.
